generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of moving house (搬家现场). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show an active but organised house move from inside the open front door looking toward one removal van outside. A mover pushes a furniture dolly carrying exactly two plain moving boxes, keeping the wheels and handles visible. In the middle ground, a tall wardrobe carton stands apart from a sofa under one fitted dust cover and folded moving blanket. Place the packing tape, roll of bubble wrap and broad-tip marker separately on one open box in the foreground, and show the door wedge securing the door. Clear morning light, realistic lifting posture, minimal incidental boxes, no labels, printed arrows or company branding.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: moving box, packing tape, bubble wrap, furniture dolly, removal van, moving blanket, broad-tip marker, wardrobe moving carton, sofa dust cover, door wedge.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
